delete.description: Replaces the join code with a newly generated one and resets its usage count. Each call mints a different code and invalidates the previous one, so a retry invalidates the code the first call issued: not idempotent.

patch.description: Updates a board. Send at least one of name, all_access, auto_postpone_period_in_days or public_description: the controller expects a `board` object, so a body without any of them (including one carrying only user_ids) is a 400.
Updates a column. Send at least one of name or color: the controller expects a `column` object, so an empty body is a 400.

get.description: Lists the board's webhooks. Fizzy pages this list (a Link header with rel="next"); this operation returns the first page.

patch.description: Updates a webhook's name or subscribed actions. Send at least one: the controller expects a `webhook` object, so an empty body is a 400. The URL can't change after creation; delete the webhook and create a new one.

parameters.name: indexed_by
parameters.description: Which cards to list: "all" (default, open cards), "maybe" (awaiting triage), "closed", "not_now", "stalled", "postponing_soon" or "golden". Any other value lists the same cards as "all".

schema.description: Which cards to list: "all" (default, open cards), "maybe" (awaiting triage), "closed", "not_now", "stalled", "postponing_soon" or "golden". Any other value lists the same cards as "all".

parameters.name: sorted_by
parameters.description: "latest" (default, most recently active first), "newest" or "oldest" (by creation). Any other value sorts as "latest".

schema.description: "latest" (default, most recently active first), "newest" or "oldest" (by creation). Any other value sorts as "latest".

parameters.name: assignment_status
parameters.description: "unassigned" lists only cards with no assignee; any other value is ignored.

schema.description: "unassigned" lists only cards with no assignee; any other value is ignored.

parameters.name: creation
parameters.description: Created within: "today", "yesterday", "thisweek", "lastweek", "thismonth", "lastmonth", "thisyear" or "lastyear" (TimeWindowParser); any other value is ignored.

schema.description: Created within: "today", "yesterday", "thisweek", "lastweek", "thismonth", "lastmonth", "thisyear" or "lastyear" (TimeWindowParser); any other value is ignored.

parameters.name: closure
parameters.description: Closed within: "today", "yesterday", "thisweek", "lastweek", "thismonth", "lastmonth", "thisyear" or "lastyear" (TimeWindowParser); any other value is ignored.

schema.description: Closed within: "today", "yesterday", "thisweek", "lastweek", "thismonth", "lastmonth", "thisyear" or "lastyear" (TimeWindowParser); any other value is ignored.

patch.description: Updates a card. Send at least one of title, description, image or created_at: the controller expects a `card` object, so an empty body is a 400. Moving a card between columns is TriageCard, and between boards MoveCard.

post.description: Assigns the user to the card, or unassigns them if they are already assigned. This is a toggle: calling it again undoes it, and both outcomes return 204, so a retry or a repeat reverses the first call. Check the card first when the outcome matters.
Moves the card to Not Now. Each call records an event, which notifies webhooks and adds a system comment to the card, even when the card's state doesn't change, so it is not safe to retry.

delete.description: Unpins the card for the caller. Unpinning a card the caller hasn't pinned currently fails with a 500 (Card::Pinnable#unpin_by destroys a pin it didn't find), so a retry after a success fails: not idempotent.
Marks the caller's notification for the card unread. When the caller has no notification for the card, the call succeeds without changing anything.

post.description: Marks the caller's notification for the card read. When the caller has no notification for the card, the call succeeds without changing anything.

Assigns the caller to the card, or unassigns them if they are already assigned. This is a toggle: calling it again undoes it, and both outcomes return 204, so a retry or a repeat reverses the first call. Check the card first when the outcome matters.

patch.description: Updates a step. Send at least one of content or completed: the controller expects a `step` object, so an empty body is a 400.

post.description: Tags the card, or untags it if it already has the tag. The tag is created when the account has none with that title. This is a toggle: calling it again undoes it, and both outcomes return 204, so a retry or a repeat reverses the first call. Check the card first when the outcome matters.

delete.description: Sends the card back to triage (Maybe?). Each call records an event, which notifies webhooks and adds a system comment to the card, even when the card's state doesn't change, so it is not safe to retry.

post.description: Triages the card into a column of its board. Each call records an event, which notifies webhooks and adds a system comment to the card, even when the card's state doesn't change, so it is not safe to retry.
Swaps the column with its left neighbor. Each call moves it again, so it is not idempotent; at the leftmost edge there is no neighbor and the call succeeds without changing anything.
Swaps the column with its right neighbor. Each call moves it again, so it is not idempotent; at the rightmost edge there is no neighbor and the call succeeds without changing anything.

patch.description: Sets the caller's time zone. The name isn't validated: one that ActiveSupport::TimeZone doesn't recognize is stored, succeeds with 204, and reads back as UTC.

get.description: Lists the caller's notifications. It takes no read/unread filter: the first page holds up to 100 unread notifications followed by a page of read ones, and later pages hold read ones only.

post.description: Marks every unread notification of the caller read. It takes no selection.

notification_ids.description: Ignored: Notifications::BulkReadingsController reads no ids and marks every unread notification read whatever this holds.

auto_postpone_period_in_days.description: Days of inactivity before a card is auto-postponed. One of 3, 7, 11, 30, 90 or 365 (Entropy::AUTO_POSTPONE_PERIODS_IN_DAYS); any other value is rejected with 422.

board_id.description: The board to create the card on. Required: CardsController finds it unconditionally.

image.description: The signed blob id of an image uploaded with CreateDirectUpload. A caller that can't make the upload has no value to send here.

color.description: The column color, as its CSS value: "var(--color-card-default)" (Blue), "var(--color-card-1)" (Gray), "var(--color-card-2)" (Tan), "var(--color-card-3)" (Yellow), "var(--color-card-4)" (Lime), "var(--color-card-5)" (Aqua), "var(--color-card-6)" (Violet), "var(--color-card-7)" (Purple) or "var(--color-card-8)" (Pink) (Color::COLORS). Any other value is stored but reads back as Blue.

subscribed_actions.description: The events to deliver, from: "card_assigned", "card_closed", "card_postponed", "card_auto_postponed", "card_board_changed", "card_published", "card_reopened", "card_sent_back_to_triage", "card_triaged", "card_unassigned" and "comment_created" (Webhook::PERMITTED_ACTIONS). Unknown actions are dropped silently. A webhook created without any receives no deliveries.

board_id.description: The destination board. Cards::BoardsController reads no column.

tag_title.description: The tag's title; surrounding whitespace and a leading "#" are stripped.

column_id.description: A column on the card's board. Required: the controller finds it unconditionally.

auto_postpone_period_in_days.description: Days of inactivity before a card is auto-postponed. One of 3, 7, 11, 30, 90 or 365 (Entropy::AUTO_POSTPONE_PERIODS_IN_DAYS); any other value is rejected with 422. Required: an empty body is a 400.

name.description: The account name. Required: the controller expects an `account` object, so an empty body is a 400.

auto_postpone_period_in_days.description: Days of inactivity before a card is auto-postponed. One of 3, 7, 11, 30, 90 or 365 (Entropy::AUTO_POSTPONE_PERIODS_IN_DAYS); any other value is rejected with 422. Required: an empty body is a 400.

involvement.description: The caller's involvement with the board: "access_only" or "watching" (Access#involvement). Required: the controller assigns it unconditionally.

auto_postpone_period_in_days.description: Days of inactivity before a card is auto-postponed. One of 3, 7, 11, 30, 90 or 365 (Entropy::AUTO_POSTPONE_PERIODS_IN_DAYS); any other value is rejected with 422.

user_ids.description: Replaces the board's membership: users listed are granted access and every current member not listed loses it. Omit it to leave access unchanged. It can't be sent alone (see the operation).

image.description: The signed blob id of an image uploaded with CreateDirectUpload. A caller that can't make the upload has no value to send here.

color.description: The column color, as its CSS value: "var(--color-card-default)" (Blue), "var(--color-card-1)" (Gray), "var(--color-card-2)" (Tan), "var(--color-card-3)" (Yellow), "var(--color-card-4)" (Lime), "var(--color-card-5)" (Aqua), "var(--color-card-6)" (Violet), "var(--color-card-7)" (Purple) or "var(--color-card-8)" (Pink) (Color::COLORS). Any other value is stored but reads back as Blue.

usage_limit.description: How many times the join code can be redeemed. Fizzy accepts up to 10,000,000,000, but this 32-bit field holds at most 2,147,483,647. Required: an empty body is a 400.

timezone_name.description: An IANA or Rails time zone name, such as "America/Chicago" or "Central Time (US & Canada)".

bundle_email_frequency.description: "never", "every_few_hours", "daily" or "weekly" (User::Settings#bundle_email_frequency). Required: an empty body is a 400.

name.description: Required: the controller expects a `user` object, so an empty body is a 400.

role.description: "member" or "admin". Any other value, including "owner", sets the role to "member" (Users::RolesController#role_params), so a typo demotes.

subscribed_actions.description: The events to deliver, from: "card_assigned", "card_closed", "card_postponed", "card_auto_postponed", "card_board_changed", "card_published", "card_reopened", "card_sent_back_to_triage", "card_triaged", "card_unassigned" and "comment_created" (Webhook::PERMITTED_ACTIONS). Unknown actions are dropped silently. The list replaces the current subscription.
